$comment: Branches on this repository that MUST NOT be deleted, in a form a sweep can read.
WHY THIS FILE EXISTS: a sweep that deletes 'merged branches with no open PR' takes
all three of these. The CATEGORY they fall in is 'merged, no open PR'. The PROPERTY
that matters is 'has no other home', and those two come apart on exactly these
branches. Only a reader who has read CLAUDE.md knows which -- so the exception was
prose, and prose is not readable by the thing that would violate it.
WHAT THIS FILE DOES NOT DO: it does not protect anything by itself. A branch sweep
that never reads it is unaffected by it, and a file nobody reads is a label with no
consequence. The protection has two halves and only one of them lives here:
1. this data, and a test asserting it agrees with CLAUDE.md   (this repository)
2. every branch sweep reading it before deleting               (the sweep's owner)
Half two is not implemented here and cannot be. Saying so is the point: an exception
documented on the protected side and enforced on the acting side is not an exception,
it is a hope with a filename.

retained.reason: The claude-peers broker code currently running.
The rollback target for the running broker. Contains the destroys-undelivered-mail bug itself, kept deliberately because a rollback target must be what it actually was.
Archived broker work, not reachable from FAM's main.

why_a_diff_cannot_decide_this: All three fork from 640183f and every one is strictly superseded: the only lines they
hold that main lacks are the ORIGINALS of code main has since replaced. So a tree diff
reports them as containing nothing new, which is what being superseded looks like --
They were never pull requests, so a sweep that subtracts merged-PR heads surfaces all
three every time. That is a true observation with a settled answer, recorded here so
the answer does not have to be re-derived, and so it can be re-derived by a program
rather than by a person who happens to have read the right paragraph.
